assumptions.assumption: The model assumes that a BqlModel can have multiple Queries, Predicates, and Entries, but does not specify the exact relationships between these elements.

verifier_problems_last.issue: Requirement R5 (A predicate of some query) is not represented in the model.
verifier_problems_last.fix: Add a class for Predicate and relate it to Query.

verifier_problems_last.issue: Requirement R6 (An expression) is not represented in the model.
Requirement R7 (A BQL model contains queries and entries. Each query is composed of zero or more entries) is not represented in the model.
verifier_problems_last.fix: Add a use case that realizes the relationship between BqlModel and Query, and between Query and Entry.

verifier_problems_last.issue: Requirement R8 (A BQL model has entries and fields. Each field is composed by one or more fields) is not represented in the model.
verifier_problems_last.fix: This requirement seems contradictory. Fields cannot be composed of one or more fields. Clarify the requirement.

verifier_problems_last.issue: Requirement R9 (A BQL model has fields and entries. Each field is associated to exactly one entry) is not represented in the model.
verifier_problems_last.fix: Add a use case that realizes the relationship between Field and Entry with a one-to-one association.

verifier_problems_last.issue: Requirement R10 (A BQL model has predicates and entries. Each Predicate is associated to exactly one entry) is not represented in the model.
verifier_problems_last.fix: Add a use case that realizes the relationship between Predicate and Entry with a one-to-one association.
